provider: Comet ML (Comet / Opik) — artifact + dataset management

free_tier.stated: No storage allowance at all on the free tier. The free cloud plan is metered in spans, not bytes: 'Up to 10 team members · 25k spans per month · 60-day data retention'. Artifact/dataset management is a paid-MLOps feature; the free plan is the Opik observability product with a 60-day retention clamp.
free_tier.notes: Headline offer; binding constraint specified in limits.

per_object_cap.stated: No per-object cap documented in published terms; absence is not an unlimited claim.
per_object_cap.notes: extraction found no per-object clause; some of these providers meter on object count rather than bytes, and some state no cap

retention.stated: The free cloud plan is metered in spans, not bytes: 'Up to 10 team members · 25k spans per month · 60-day data retention'

egress.terms: Not applicable. There is no free storage pool to egress from.

tooling: Comet_ml Python SDK (log_artifact, log_dataset), plus Opik's own SDK. Self-hostable: github.com/comet-ml/opik is open source, which is the only unlimited path. On your own disks.
chaining: None. With no free byte allowance, multiplying accounts multiplies zero.
limits_note: 25k spans/month, 10 team members, 60-day data retention on Free. Retention is the killer: 60 days is a hard clamp, so this cannot hold an archive even if bytes were free.

identity_cost.detail: email; academic Pro requires institutional verification.

reliability_note: Free tier enforces an automatic 60-day retention limit that cannot be overridden by client settings.

extras.agent_focus: New and up-and-coming competitors to Hugging Face and ModelScope, judged on the hard test the brief sets: a credible HF competitor must permit multi-TB objects and generous per-account storage, because model weights and datasets routinely run to hundreds of GB / TiB. Split into three classes — Chinese domestic hubs (HF is blocked there, so a separate ecosystem exists), Western MLOps artifact stores (W&B/Comet/ClearML/Lightning/Deep Lake), and dataset-publishing startups (Source Cooperative, Oxen, OpenDataLab). Excluded and not re-reported: Hugging Face, ModelScope, Kaggle, Civitai, Ollama, Replicate, DagsHub, OpenML, fal.ai, Baseten, Modal.

binding_note: a clock, not a quota: bytes leave whether or not transfer is completed
